evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, trigger() still treats every quoted span from the finding as a trigger: it returns outcome 'fail' / reason 'deleted-trigger-survives' whenever any span remains in after content or a cited dependency. This check runs before the later supportedTrigger gate and does not require the surviving span to occur on a removed line. Thus a quoted symbol such as 'load' can cause a false failure even when the actual defect text was removed. The current contract does not supersede this ordinary correctness defect.
